posts.title: Creatine built muscle even without exercise, trial finds
posts.excerpt: Adults taking 10 grams of creatine a day gained about 2.4 pounds of lean tissue over 12 weeks with no structured exercise program, a September Texas A&M trial found. Those who paired the same dose…
posts.body: Adults taking 10 grams of creatine a day gained about 2.4 pounds of lean tissue over 12 weeks with no structured exercise program, [a September Texas A&M trial](https://www.womenfitness.net/news-flash/creatine-build-muscle-without/) found. Those who paired the same dose with training three times a week and a modest calorie deficit added nearly 3 pounds of lean tissue while cutting more body fat than the placebo group, which the researchers call the first trial to show the combo beating diet and exercise alone on body-fat percentage.

posts.title: 60 weekly sets built no more muscle than 40
posts.excerpt: In the Finnish trial, 27 trained athletes who pushed leg training to about 60 weekly sets gained no significant extra muscle or strength over the group holding near 40, with deadlift gains actually…
posts.body: In the [Finnish trial](https://macrosmeasure.com/blog/is-there-a-ceiling-on-training-volume-what-the-63-sets-a-week-study-says-about-more-is-better), 27 trained athletes who pushed leg training to about 60 weekly sets gained no significant extra muscle or strength over the group holding near 40, with deadlift gains actually favoring the lower-volume group, 6.3% versus 4.3%. A separate October systematic review found volume load (sets × reps × weight) the variable most consistently tied to hypertrophy: progressive overload is the engine, and extra sets past the productive zone mostly add fatigue.

posts.title: 51 lawmakers urge agencies to reverse fast-track child deportations
posts.excerpt: Representative Andrea Salinas of Oregon and Senator Ron Wyden of Oregon led 51 members of Congress in an October 16 letter to the Justice Department, the Executive Office for Immigration Review, ICE,…
posts.body: Representative Andrea Salinas of Oregon and Senator Ron Wyden of Oregon led 51 members of Congress in an October 16 letter to the Justice Department, the Executive Office for Immigration Review, ICE, and USCIS urging the administration to "immediately reverse course" on accelerated deportation proceedings for unaccompanied children, citing 24-hour asylum-interview notices, large "mega master" hearings, limits on continuances, and reduced access to lawyers, per [VisaVerge's writeup](https://www.visaverge.com/legal/andrea-salinas-ron-wyden-lead-lawmakers-in-letter-on-unaccompanied-children-deportations/). The letter demands answers to 25 questions by October 30, 2026, with the Acacia Center for Justice endorsing it and a full public copy included, per the [press-release mirror](https://www.quiverquant.com/news/Press%20Release:%20Andrea%20Salinas%20and%20Ron%20Wyden%20Lead%20Lawmakers%20in%20Letter%20on%20Unaccompanied%20Children%20Deportations); it is oversight pressure rather than a remedy, and it stands apart from the legal-service providers' October 15 lawsuit covered earlier on this feed.

posts.body: A review published Oct 13 in Sports Medicine [asks whether muscle growth itself helps muscles resist fatigue](https://www.mensjournal.com/health/bigger-muscles-may-have-a-hidden-benefit-that-goes-beyond-lifting-heavier-weights), potentially letting you do more reps before tiring. The authors found size and endurance often improve together, but say no causal relationship can be established yet.

posts.excerpt: A Reddit fork rebuilds PS5LM as a native PS5 app on the PS5_Vulkan driver, lifting usable memory from about 6 GB to 11.4 GB. That turns Qwen 3.8 27B from a one-token-a-minute CPU curiosity into about…
posts.body: A Reddit fork [rebuilds PS5LM as a native PS5 app](https://www.alextech.ai/en/news/a-jailbroken-ps5-now-runs-gguf-models-on-its-gpu-via-ps5lm/) on the PS5_Vulkan driver, lifting usable memory from about 6 GB to 11.4 GB. That turns Qwen 3.8 27B from a one-token-a-minute CPU curiosity into about 20 tokens per second on the GPU.
